# Official Sweden Staging Qualification

Read and follow `.github/skills/test-agent-validation/SKILL.md`. This is the current official staging
qualification for new candidates. Validation is local and report-free; GitHub runs only ordinary
mechanical CI.

Before any cloud mutation, acquire the environment-namespaced OS lock, verify one clean local commit is the exact head of
its inferred open PR, resolve the authenticated Azure CLI user, recover any incomplete local journal
through run-scoped exact cleanup, measure model quota/headroom, verify read-only Sweden `g30` access,
and bind the exact durable `aiq-staging-swedencentral` Account and Project.

Reconcile exactly 41 stable baseline/issue Agent endpoints in that Project. Persist and exact-select
the server-assigned provider version and content digest for every authority. Invoke only those deployed
endpoints. Use the catalog-frozen mode and fixed setup/probe attempts, run every issue against paired
`v0`, and query only `g30` telemetry. Never create a monitor, run Agent Insights, assess or report
cards, publish ADX, send email, run Daily, or write validation lifecycle/evidence to Blob.

Keep required content-addressed history, evidence, and CLEAN proof under
`~/.aiq-runtime/agent-insights-quality/test-agent-validation/`. On any commit drift, ambiguous
correlation/create/delete, quota loss, or substrate failure, fail closed and clean run-scoped resources
exactly. Never delete or replace the durable Project, mutate the legacy West US 2 lifecycle, reuse
cross-cycle evidence, or fall back to the legacy environment.

The successful run creates no approval artifact. Only after explicit user approval may the separate
`approve-test-agent-validation` command re-read the exact PR head and local proof, then create the one
minimal immutable approved Blob record. Merge remains manual.
